title: Getting Started and Swift Syntax
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of getting started and swift syntax in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 2: Getting Started and Swift Syntax. Lessons in order: Your First Swift Program; The Swift Compilation Process; Swift Statements and Expressions; Swift Syntax and Code Structure; Comments in Swift; Identifiers and Naming Rules; Keywords and Contextual Keywords; Constants with let; Variables with var; Type Annotations and Type Inference.
